audit_scope.description: This batch covers CL fork transitions (EIP-7805 Fulu-to-EIP7805 beacon state upgrade), EL block building configuration (EIP-7872 local builder blob limit), and EL EVM state operations (Prague SLOAD/SSTORE/TLOAD/TSTORE gas economics and storage access patterns).

in_scope: Fork Transitions (EIP-7805 beacon state upgrade from Fulu)
out_of_scope: EIP-7805 behavioral changes beyond fork mechanics

in_scope: EVM Storage Operations (Prague SLOAD/SSTORE/TLOAD/TSTORE gas economics)

threats: Exploit gas pricing discrepancies between warm/cold storage access
Abuse transient storage to bypass expected state isolation
Gas griefing via storage access pattern manipulation

misclassified_entities.reason: Local configuration file, not a runtime external entity. This is a trusted local input controlled by the node operator, not crossing a trust boundary.
Protocol-defined constants embedded in client code. Not an external entity—these are hardcoded consensus parameters.
Physical network conditions are an environmental factor, not a protocol-level external entity that sends data across a trust boundary.

Blob transactions in the local mempool are internal to the node. They have already crossed the trust boundary at P2P ingestion and been validated. At the block-building stage they are trusted local data.

coverage_analysis.notes: All 4 external entities from source subgraphs were classified as misclassified (local configuration, protocol constants, environmental factors, or already-validated local data). No runtime trust boundary crossings identified in this batch.
